entries.note: baseline snapshot at adoption of skill-provenance/v1
inject shared interaction-policy v1 managed region
warn that reasoning models' hidden tokens consume max_tokens before answer text — give >=1024-2048 headroom in sweeps (Traigent/traigent-skills#179)

references-only: reconcile references/litellm.md max_tokens headroom floor with the canonical effort-dependent statement in traigent-optimize-config-space/references/parameter-types.md (cross-link + note >=8192 under reasoning_effort='high'); SKILL.md unchanged (Traigent/traigent-skills#211)

propagate the quickstart caveat: `traigent models --check` is an ID-shape preflight against a shipped snapshot with pattern fallback, cannot detect provider-side delisting; make the live provider catalog the authoritative liveness check in SKILL.md and references/litellm.md (Traigent/traigent-skills#227)
add portable audience, topic, lifecycle-stage, and maturity metadata; instructional body unchanged

Gemini key resolution stated in LiteLLM's actual order (GOOGLE_API_KEY first, then GEMINI_API_KEY, PALM_API_KEY accepted) in SKILL.md and references/litellm.md, so an unrelated GOOGLE_API_KEY in the shell is named as the thing that silently wins.

rebase PR #288 onto current main and sync interaction-policy v2: recommend next skills only after result-bearing steps or explicit decisions, cap recommendations at three, and attach one eligibility reason per recommendation

Rebuild issue #150 on current main: align integration dependency floors, mark the DSPy floor unverified, and preserve missing versus measured-zero best-score and cost telemetry in both W&B and MLflow examples.

Gate framework auto-override on the released SDK: on traigent<=0.27.0 it is a silent no-op, so point readers to manual injection and a keyless mock preflight; pair framework_targets with auto_override_frameworks=True and drop the unmapped Google target from the supported list.

Lead the DSPy prompt-optimizer examples with method=bootstrap and caveat that method=mipro crashes on traigent<=0.27.0, document the real DSPyPromptOptimizer and optimize_prompt signatures, and pin dspy==3.3.1 where the examples were verified.

Make the mock dry-run passable per framework (LangChain needs a non-secret placeholder key at construction; DSPy dry-runs with DummyLM because mock text cannot satisfy structured outputs) and switch in-function DSPy examples from dspy.configure to thread-safe dspy.context.
Correct the dspy.configure note: a trial fails only when all of its examples land on a non-configuring thread; otherwise its accuracy is silently deflated.
Widen the DSPy method=mipro crash caveat from <=0.27.0 to every release through 0.30.0 (fix is unreleased) (#444).
Interaction-policy profile-seed snippet no longer uses a module-level await: asyncio.run for scripts, await shown for async callers; re-synced into every skill (#362).

Add a request-driven clause to the shared interaction policy: when asked which Skills were used, state consulted, unavailable and deferred Skills from session evidence, with an example; re-synced into every skill (#416).

Issue sweep 2026-10-21 against SDK 0.30.0: install floor >=0.24.0 with a floor-enforcing install check (#442); current Anthropic model IDs (#450); OpenAI real-run tier IDs and a litellm>=1.106.0 pin (#451); tuning-dataset path (#452); holdout reference script reads the export_config wrapper and the SDK's label keys (#453); PR-job cost limit removed and the TVL note version-stamped (#454); auth device-login and TRAIGENT_DEBUG wording (#455); ProviderValidationError, TRAIGENT_STRICT_COST_ACCOUNTING, row-metadata merge and the models --check typo claim (#447).
